title: 第5章 牛头人事件并非偶然第6章 嘿嘿危机来咯
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
30多头牛头人的肉，多的离谱，之前林恩是因为有几百号人才能带走那么多，现在完全是带不了那么多的，不过可以一点一点的售卖，不要紧的。
这个世界因为是西幻的原因耕种不是完全用牛的，也会用马。
所以不存在不能吃牛的问题。
大量的商品投入市场不能换取高额的利润，30多头牛肯定不是一口气全部卖完的。
还慢慢的来。
林恩一边想着，一边来到了砍树小队中，对着艾克雷叫道：“艾克雷，你过来。”
艾克雷立马小跑过来：“林恩大人，有何吩咐？”
“艾克雷，那些奴隶里有什么人干活干的好的吗？”
“有几个挺机灵的，还有几个力气也很大。”
“把他们带过来给我看看。”
在原地等待几分钟后，有七八个人被带了过来，全部都挺瘦的，下到14岁少年，上到30多岁的大叔，都有着自己的悲惨人生导致成为奴隶。
最高的居然和林恩差不多高，最矮的甚至只能和莉莉姆一样高。
林恩扫视一眼后，发现有一些奴隶也在偷看，当即决定大声宣布：“你们几个，很不错，干的很好，我宣布，你们将获得自由，废除奴隶身份，成为我的子民。”
在我还没有足够的经济循环之前，不能废奴，只能先激发他们的积极性了。
解除奴隶身份是很难的，这里可是魔法世界，不存在你逃走后伪装一个新身份就能获得自由，这里有奴隶项圈，魔法制造，没有主人和外人，根本解不开。
除非这个奴隶项圈等级太低了，而你本人其实是个强者。
林恩大手一挥，奴隶项圈自动脱离，那几个人面面相觑，随后立刻跪倒在地使劲磕头：“多谢林恩大人，多谢林恩大人。”
十分幸运的能解除奴隶身份，让他们感激涕零。
“这是对你们努力干活的奖励！”林恩再次拉高声音，让所有人都能听见：“从今往后的每个星期，我都会挑选你们之中最优秀的人，解除奴隶身份！”
“你们几个，要来当我的士兵吗？”林恩说完这一切后立刻就向刚刚解除了奴隶身份的几人发出邀请：“我将招募你们几个成为我的士兵，待遇和正常士兵一样，如何？”

“愿意，我们愿意。”几个人立刻回复。
现在的士兵就是大爷，这些奴隶是士兵和骑士们在管，这相当于从奴隶身份变为了主人，他们当然愿意拉。
“那就好，你们几个把名字告诉我，我去修改一下你们的档案。”
“艾克雷，你现在的任务是训练他们，过几天后挑一些人，我要组个商队。”
接下来的几天时间里，林恩也是毫不留情的把自己也当牲口用。
上午指挥伐木，烧制木炭，用泥土制造砖头，收集石头。
下午烧制砖块，同时指挥房屋的建设。
骑士和士兵们则进行几天的训练，恢复一下状态，准备保护商队。
......
一张地图被摆放到桌面上。
这是奥莱西安公国的地图。
林恩的全名是：林恩.奥莱西安。
由于被踢出了家族，林恩现在已经不是奥莱西安的人了。
帝国四大公，东南西北，奥莱西安是属于北境的大公国。
帝国的北方敌人是兽人，亚人，西方威胁是魔族，南方是哥布林，东方是其他人类国家。
其中兽人是部落制度，偶尔刷新出类似于大可汗的角色，会给帝国造成威胁。
content_en:
The meat of more than 30 tauren was ridiculously large. In the past, Lin En could only take so much because he had hundreds of people, but now he couldn't take so much, but he could sell it bit by bit, so it didn't matter.
Because this world is a Western Fantasy, farming does not entirely use cattle, but also horses.
So there is no problem of not eating cows.
Putting a large amount of goods into the market cannot be exchanged for high profits, and more than 30 cows will certainly not be sold out in one go.
Come slowly.
While thinking about it, Linn came to the tree-cutting team and shouted to Aikere: "Aikere, come here."
Aikeli immediately trotted over: "Master Linn, what are your orders?"
"Ikere, are any of those slaves doing a good job?"
"Some of them are quite clever, and some of them are very strong."
"Bring them here and show them to me."
After waiting on the spot for a few minutes, seven or eight people were brought over, all of them quite thin. They ranged from 14-year-old boys to 30-year-old uncles. They all had their own tragic lives that led to them becoming slaves.
The tallest one is actually about the same height as Lin En, and the shortest one is only as tall as Lilim.
After Lin En glanced around, he found that some slaves were also peeking. He immediately decided to announce loudly: "You guys are very good and have done a good job. I declare that you will be free, abolish slavery, and become my people."
Before I have enough economic circulation, I cannot abolish slavery. I can only stimulate their enthusiasm first.
It is very difficult to get rid of the slave status. This is a magical world. There is no way that you can escape and pretend to be a new identity to gain freedom. There are slave collars here, which are made by magic. There are no masters and outsiders, so it cannot be undone at all.
Unless this slave collar is too low level and you are actually a strong person.
Lin En waved his hand, and the slave collar automatically detached. The few people looked at each other, and then immediately knelt down and kowtowed vigorously: "Thank you, Lord Lin En, thank you, Lord Lin En."
They were very lucky to be released from slavery, which made them burst into tears of gratitude.
"This is a reward for your hard work!" Linn raised his voice again so that everyone could hear: "Every week from now on, I will select the best among you to release your slave status!"
"Are you guys going to be my soldiers?" After Linn said all this, he immediately extended an invitation to the few people who had just been released from their slave status: "I will recruit a few of you to become my soldiers, and you will be treated the same as normal soldiers. How about that?"
"Yes, we are willing." Several people responded immediately.
Now the soldiers are the masters, and these slaves are managed by soldiers and knights. This is equivalent to changing from slave status to master. Of course they are willing to take them.
"That's good, you guys tell me your names and I'll modify your files."
"Aikere, your task now is to train them. In a few days, I will select some people and I will form a caravan."
In the next few days, Lin En also used himself as an animal without mercy.
In the morning, he directed cutting down trees, burning charcoal, making bricks from soil, and collecting stones.
In the afternoon the bricks were fired and the construction of the house was directed at the same time.
The knights and soldiers trained for a few days to recover and prepare to protect the caravan.
...
A map is placed on the table.
This is a map of the Principality of Olesian.
Lynn's full name is: Lynn Olesian.
Due to being kicked out of the family, Linn is no longer an Olesian.
The four great duchies of the empire are divided into the southeast, northwest and Olesian. Olesian is the grand duchy belonging to the north.
The empire's northern enemies are orcs and demihumans, the western threats are demons, the southern threats are goblins, and the eastern threats are other human nations.
Among them, the orcs are a tribal system, and characters similar to the Great Khan are occasionally refreshed, which will pose a threat to the empire.
